clues.text: In the wilderness, John preached this as a sign of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
When Jesus came up out of the water after this, the Spirit of God descended on Him like a dove.
In the temple courts, Jesus asked the chief priests whether John's version of this came from heaven or from men.
Peter told the crowd to repent and receive this in Jesus' name, promising them the gift of the Holy Spirit.
Jesus sent His disciples to all nations, to give this in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Paul wrote that believers were buried with Christ through this, so they may walk in newness of life.
Peter wrote that the water which saved Noah's family in the ark symbolizes this, which now saves you.
